node.title: Anchor exchange eliminates the nonzero affine-reflection rational branch
node.closure: 5524 synchronized anchor locators exceed the exact 1154-fiber cap for every fixed nonzero official affine reflection
node.statement: In the official dense-anchor heavy-ruling route, consider the rational exception branch with e=2 whose normalized pencil pairs roots by x -> c-x for a fixed c!=0. Apply the anchor-exchange synchronization theorem. If a base or one-swap packet emits high complexity, then chi>=2299571. Otherwise one fixed rational pencil contains all 5524 pairwise-disjoint anchor exception locators. Since any one split fiber has roots in the base-field domain, c is in F_p^*, and the exact official census caps this pencil at 1154 fibers, a contradiction. Thus the nonzero affine-reflection rational subbranch always routes to chi>=2299571. The high-complexity output is not paid here; c=0 and nonaffine pencils remain separate.
